kind.description: decided by the fetch tool, never by a model; papers live in atlas-research-content

newsletter_source.description: the newsletter-source record an issue belongs to; present only on kind newsletter

series.description: the name of the series of its newsletter an issue belongs to, copied by code from the source's `series` list; present only on kind newsletter

series_issue.description: the issue number a `title_pattern` series found in the title, copied by code; present only with `series`, and only for a numbered series

oneOf.description: a newsletter issue: copied from the publisher's feed by code
a news item: ranked, tagged and summarized by a model
